Method of Attack: Exploiting CVE-2023-4911 (Looney Tunables) for privilege escalation
Impacted Systems: Linux systems vulnerable to Looney Tunables (glibc 2.34+)
Cloud-based systems and applications including Kubernetes, Docker APIs, Redis, Jenkins
Kubernetes clusters with misconfigured PostgreSQL containers
Attack Vector: Downloading and executing privilege escalation exploit from public PoC repository
Indicators of Compromise: Use of CVE-2023-4911 exploit fetched from public PoC repository
